workstream: Wave E — ball tracking on the D2-06 hard-slice gold labels
grouping: Evaluation grouped by independent source recording / session (4 bundles from 3 recordings); no random-frame splits. Denominators are the committed D2-06 gold labels; nothing resampled.

measurementBoundary.environment: LINUX-CPU pose-free proxy (Ubuntu, ffmpeg 4.4.2, tools/paddle-lab/ball_candidates.py 3-frame differencing → real tracker code buildBallTracks → selectPrimaryBallTrack)
measurementBoundary.inert: No Apple Vision pose (macOS-only) so the play-band and body-dwell gates and the body-occlusion machine are inert; no paddle track so paddle-proximity gates are inert (paddleTrackExists=false).
measurementBoundary.blockedExternal: Canonical Mac cascade numbers for these slices remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (no Mac/Apple Vision on this box).

configuration.candidates: datasets/experiments/wave-e/e12-ball-hard-slices/candidates/*.json (committed, regenerated on this box from the registered PD/CC sources)
configuration.scoring: scoreBallOcclusionCase (ballOcclusionBench): hit radius 0.05, match tolerance 40ms, per occlusion bucket; bridge honesty (predicted never canonical) checked per window

labelVerification.claim: Every one of the 39 labeled points has a raw motion candidate within the 0.05 hit radius in a ±40ms frame window; median nearest-candidate distance ≈ 0.005, worst 0.047 (afn-sasebo-rally2 2736).
labelVerification.meaning: Candidate generation (stage A) is NOT the bottleneck on these slices; failures are association/gating/selection.

forensicRootCauses.failure: wavea-wgm-wheelchair: BEFORE, the selected primary was a camera-pan streak (whole scene sweeps right→left at ~1.7 u/s from ~182933; ≥14 gate-passing parallel tracks in lockstep). A pan streak was scored as the best 'ball'.
forensicRootCauses.fix: Global-motion coherence gate: per-track fraction of steps whose velocity matches ≥4 other concurrent tracks (±25°, speed ratio ≤1.55, ≥0.5 u/s); tracks with >0.5 coherent steps are rejected (BALL_GATES2.maxCoherentMotionFraction, counted in ablation.stageC_coherenceRejected). Camera motion moves the scene in lockstep; a ball is a velocity outlier.
forensicRootCauses.measured: stageC_coherenceRejected per window AFTER: wavea-wgm-wheelchair 94, afn-sasebo-rally2 2, all static-camera windows 0 (no collateral damage). The wgm primary is no longer a pan streak.
forensicRootCauses.secondaryFix: jerkyMinStepNorm 0.008: direction flips between sub-noise-floor steps (few-px centroid wobble) no longer count as jerky turns — angle between near-zero displacements is measurement noise, not physics.

forensicRootCauses.failure: Remaining dominant failure (NOT fixed, root-caused): pose/paddle-context-free primary selection prefers persistent limb/scene tracks over the true ball transit. Evidence: wm-volley-02 track 582 passes ALL gates and hits 4/4 gold points but loses selection to limb track 579 (goldHits 0/4) because the score rewards window overlap (1480ms vs 320ms) and length (31 vs 9 obs). Similarly afn-sasebo-rally2's best-covering track (8/11 gold hits) fails jerky+chronic gates while decoy track 333 (0/11) passes and is selected — the 2 OCCLUDED 'violations' are canonical observations from that decoy, not a prediction leak; bridge honesty held everywhere (predicted points never entered canonical observations).
forensicRootCauses.whyNotFixed: Re-weighting primary selection against these 4 bundles with no usable held-out set (wm-dink-01 / afn-vic-rally1 are untouchable) would be tuning to the training slices, and any regression on the canonical wave-C benchmarks is unverifiable from this Linux box (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL). In production the limb decoys are exactly what the pose body-dwell and paddle gates remove — gates that are inert in this proxy.

honesty: Aggregate hit count is UNCHANGED (4/35 OBSERVED before and after): the coherence gate removes the camera-pan artifact class (proven by the 94-vs-0 rejection split between the panning and static windows and by the wgm primary no longer being a pan streak) but the next-best decoy is limb motion, which needs the pose/paddle context this Linux proxy cannot provide.
fastBlur miss 5→2 / wrongLoc 1→4 reflects the new wgm primary overlapping gold timestamps at wrong locations — reported as-is, not spun as improvement.

The 2 OCCLUDED violations are decoy-track canonical observations, not predicted-bridge leaks; OBSERVED→OCCLUDED/PREDICTED→REACQUIRED/LOST semantics and the predicted-never-observed contract are untouched (verified by the bridge-honesty check in every window and the 27 passing tracker/occlusion tests).
No thresholds were weakened; both changes are additive gates/floors with regression tests (camera-pan lockstep rejection; sub-noise-floor wobble).
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never viewed, labeled, or evaluated.
